summary: A fork of the X0X groovebox with a 909, an 808, two 303s and a breakbeat player, adding pattern remixing, Grids-based drum generation and an extended 303 line generator.
features: 909 and 808 drum machines, two Open303-based basses, an 8-slice break player
Per-part length (1-64 steps) and rate; bar-quantized pattern chaining
Remix: separate bank and pattern picks per part, stored steps kept
Grids MAP/EUCLID kick, snare and hat generation with Undo
TB-3PO with 22 scales; experimental Morph waveform on one 303
Browser backup and restore over USB; user loops in three sample slots
